items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: no, Kid Olive wasn't there. There's Kid Orange, Johnny Dots, Baby Dots, Lorenzo Stahl on guitar, and Bob Lyons on bass. That's how it was.

ctx.x: Well, Chris was a nice man with a plunger, you know. He was a plunger man. Yeah, I know. Well, I'm going to tell you how this happened. When I first came here from the Army, somebody carried me down to 25, where Louis was playing. And I got up there and played two numbers over there and some other song I played. And oh, that's the, let me see what, no, Kid Olive wasn't there. There's Kid Orange, Johnny Dots, Baby Dots, Lorenzo Stahl on guitar, and Bob Lyons on bass. That's how it was. And I played them two tunes…
Well was Louis copying anybody at that time? Did he have his own style already?
